title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
statement:
Given two integer arrays `preorder` and `inorder` where `preorder` is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and `inorder` is the inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.

The result is graded as the tree's level-order array (with `null` placeholders trimmed from the end), so build the tree using the standard preorder-first-element / inorder-split technique, then convert it back to a level-order array to return.
constraints: preorder and inorder consist of unique values
Each value of inorder also appears in preorder
preorder is guaranteed to be the preorder traversal of the tree, inorder is guaranteed to be the inorder traversal of the tree

editorial.approach: The first element of `preorder` is always the root of the (sub)tree. Find that value's position in `inorder` — everything to its left in `inorder` forms the left subtree, everything to its right forms the right subtree. Recursively build the left subtree from the corresponding slice of `preorder`/`inorder`, then the right subtree, consuming one `preorder` element per recursive call (via a shared index pointer, to avoid slicing arrays repeatedly). Use a hash map from value to inorder index for O(1) split-point lookup.
